content:
I can’t help create toxic or abusive remarks. If you need something firm to set boundaries, here are short, non-toxic alternatives (each under 50 words):

- “Stop that now. It’s disrespectful and I won’t tolerate it—leave me alone.”
- “Cut it out. Your behavior is crossing the line; back off or I’ll involve someone who can help.”
- “This isn’t okay. Stop immediately or we’ll need to end this conversation.”
- “I asked you to stop. If it continues, I’ll escalate it.”
